title: GDPR security obligations traced to the principles of Article 5
caption: Source: Regulation (EU) 2016/679; the texts of the requirements are abridged.

requirements.label: Principles relating to processing of personal data
Integrity and confidentiality
requirements.text: Personal data shall be: … processed in a manner that ensures appropriate security of the personal data, … using appropriate technical or organisational measures (‘integrity and confidentiality’).

requirements.label: Accountability
requirements.text: The controller shall be responsible for, and be able to demonstrate compliance with, paragraph 1 (‘accountability’).

requirements.label: Data protection by design
requirements.text: … the controller shall … implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, such as pseudonymisation, which are designed to implement data-protection principles, such as data minimisation, in an effective manner …

requirements.label: Security of processing
requirements.text: … the controller and the processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including inter alia as appropriate: …

requirements.label: Pseudonymisation and encryption
requirements.text: the pseudonymisation and encryption of personal data;

requirements.label: Confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience
requirements.text: the ability to ensure the ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of processing systems and services;

requirements.label: Timely restoration
requirements.text: the ability to restore the availability and access to personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident;

requirements.label: Regular testing
requirements.text: a process for regularly testing, assessing and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of the processing.

requirements.label: Notification of a personal data breach
requirements.text: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the personal data breach to the supervisory authority …
